I'm now diving into the verifier logic to understand how branches are assessed. Specifically, I'm examining how a vertical trunk and horizontal limb, extending to the right edge, are evaluated. I'm considering a 12x12 grid and mapping out the empty and noise-filled areas to trace the paths of the trunk and limb. I'm focusing on the connection between trunk and limb and the implications of this approach.
